title: Inside Sink Drainage: How the P-Trap Protects Your Home
description: The sink drainage system relies on gravity and specific hydraulic principles to remove wastewater safely while preventing sewer gases from entering living spaces. At the heart of this system is the P-trap, a curved section of pipe designed to hold a standing water seal. Every time the sink is used, wastewater flushes through the trap, replacing the old water with fresh water and maintaining the gas barrier. Understanding how this water seal functions helps homeowners and apprentices maintain hygienic plumbing systems and troubleshoot common odor issues effectively without compromising trap integrity.
